notes.title: Please read: Final patch.
notes.content:
As mentioned in previous posts, Development of Rimward Basilisk has stopped. 
Please consider supporting it's successor - Black beacon Hill, a complete overhaul and upgrade of Rimwrad Basilisk made with some serious reflection and effort.

A good review helps out a ton!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641070/Black_Beacon_Hill/

notes.title: Part 4 release
notes.content:
- 3 new stages with new mechanics, soundtracks, characters, and a lot more story content!
Plus numerous updates to previous stages / story dialogue, and some small bugfixes.

Featuring the hardest stage of this game by far...
Part 4 will be the conclusion of Arc 1.
